title: Pickleball Intermediate Protocol
tagline: Stability. Strength. Power. Control. Court Confidence.
goal: Build on foundational movement patterns • Improve lateral quickness and control • Increase lower body strength and power • Develop upper body stability and endurance • Enhance change of direction and court skills • Play with confidence and reduced injury risk

weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.notes:
INTERMEDIATE GOALS:
- Build on foundational movement patterns
- Improve lateral quickness and control
- Increase lower body strength and power
- Develop upper body stability and endurance
- Enhance change of direction and court skills
- Play with confidence and reduced injury risk

sourceNotes: Read 6 sheets (weeks 1-6), each 1536x1024 from Drive thumbnails at w2400. Every sheet has the same layout: header (MD FIT Performance & Rehab, 'Move better.
